notes: Selected Table 4, Safety Summary During the Double-Blind Treatment Phase, TEAEs row: patients experiencing at least one treatment-emergent adverse event, the best match to the unrestricted outcome Adverse events. No population or timepoint was specified. Searched doc_registry_NCT03434041.json resultsSection.outcomeMeasuresModule (all 12 measures) and adverseEventsModule eventGroups, seriousEvents and otherEvents. The registry has results but no overall any-adverse-event count: its otherNumAffected totals are non-serious events with frequencyThreshold 5 (double-blind EG000 118/126, EG001 61/126), and seriousNumAffected is 3/126 in each group; these are narrower outcomes and cannot be combined to recover any-AE counts. Follow-up registry other-event totals are 10/106 and 13/103, and serious-event totals are 2/106 and 2/103. The separate doc_ctgov_results_NCT03434041.json contains efficacy measures, not overall adverse-event counts. Other Table 4 candidates are TEAEs possibly related to intranasal drug (117/126 and 55/126), treatment-emergent SAEs (3/126 each), TEAEs leading to death (1/126 and 0/126), and TEAEs leading to discontinuation (7/126 and 2/126). These restricted categories and individual adverse-event terms were not substituted for overall TEAEs. The surrounding paper prose repeats the selected event counts. Each denominator uses its own table column header occurrence.
